## Install before it reaches the Chrome Web Store

1. Download `reflect-capture-__VERSION__-chrome-unpacked.zip` below and unzip it. Keep the folder: Chrome loads the extension from it.
2. Open `chrome://extensions`, turn on **Developer mode**, click **Load unpacked**, and pick the unzipped folder.
3. If the Chrome Web Store copy of Reflect Capture is also installed, turn it off.

When the Web Store has __VERSION__, remove this copy and turn the store copy back on.
